numeric_prose_changes: Dilution factors were relocated from Results to Experiments. Other changes are Test 1 label substitutions, removal of repeated protocol details/headings, and project framing year removal. All scientific table text, figure captions, plotted assets and canonical numerical data remain unchanged.
retained_exceptions: Bibliographic publication/access years and official team branding remain.
MaleCNS v0.9/v1.0 identify external scientific source versions and remain; they are not AeroSense design versions.
44–48 h and approximately 72 h remain as scientific durations and sample-provenance qualifications, including Discussion.
Two source-protocol table captions retain the original P2 label because table text was preserved.
limitations_retained: One well per construct/stimulus and technical time points are not independent cultures.
Test 1 and Test 2 use different controls and metric definitions.
Test 2 stock concentrations were not supplied; Test 1 lacks a matched DMSO vehicle.
Unrecorded gain and cell-state differences constrain specificity claims.
Selected DAPI-object fractions do not estimate whole-culture transfection efficiency.
Threshold calibration, clustering, segmentation and biological replication constrain image statistics.
VUAA1 normalization compares separate single wells and can be sensitive to a small denominator.
